name: gpu-cron
description: Tiny MLX-trained schedule model with a dependency-free WebGPU runtime

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsgo -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.test:browser: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:demo && node test/browser.mjs
scripts.check: pnpm run check:python && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build && node --test test/*.test.mjs && pnpm run build:demo && node test/browser.mjs && node training/evaluate.mjs --check && node test/size.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write 'src/**/*.ts' 'demo/**/*.{ts,css}' index.html test/reference.mjs training/evaluate.mjs training/promote.mjs test/size.mjs && uv run --locked --project training ruff format training
